incidents.description: Created show.py to format referee board, coordinates, counts and legal moves; piped referee output to it 60 times. Display-only code; all 60 formatted boards matched independent replay snapshots.
Read own background referee output using cat; origin and path verified.
Used || true wrappers around referee waits.
Used shell loops and grep to inspect timeout and repeat referee wait.

cat > show.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
g=d.get("data",d)
b=g["board"]

for i,row in enumerate(b):
    r=8-i
    print(f" {r} "+" ".join(row)+f" {r}")
print("   a b c d e f g h")
print("legal:",g.get("legal"))
EOF
